evidence: Users who employ "Delayed Swap" or similar hedged strategies are severely penalized. Instead of receiving capital efficiency (netting), they are subject to a collateral requirement that increases with their credit position. This completely breaks the risk model for these strategies, potentially leading to unfair liquidations or making the strategy economically unviable (DoS of functionality).
